title: Data Structures
summary: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, and graphs — chosen and analysed by the operations a problem actually needs.
outcomes: Choose a data structure by the cost of the operations a problem requires
Analyse time and space complexity with asymptotic notation
Implement and traverse trees and graphs
Apply sorting and searching techniques appropriately
